    (2025, "fossil","gas",      "Major pension funds divest from new gas exploration",                6),
]

share_data = [
    (2000, 19.2), (2002, 19.5), (2004, 19.8), (2006, 20.3), (2008, 20.9),
    (2010, 21.7), (2012, 23.1), (2014, 24.8), (2015, 25.6), (2016, 26.5),
    (2017, 27.4), (2018, 28.6), (2019, 29.8), (2020, 31.5), (2021, 32.8),
    (2022, 34.6), (2023, 37.2), (2024, 39.8), (2025, 42.0), (2027, 46.5),
    (2030, 52.0), (2033, 57.5), (2035, 62.0),
]

# ── Color palette (editorial, accessible) ────────────────────────────────────
SUB_COLORS = {
    "coal":     "#2d2d2d",   # charcoal
    "oil":      "#8B4513",   # saddle brown
    "gas":      "#C17F2A",   # amber
    "solar":    "#F4B400",   # golden yellow
    "wind":     "#1A73E8",   # strong blue
    "hydrogen": "#0F9D58",   # emerald
}

BG_COLOR    = "#F5F5F0"
GRID_COLOR  = "#D8D8D0"
ACCENT_ZONE = "#FFE8A0"      # inflection zone highlight

# ── Layout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 11), facecolor=BG_COLOR)

# Two plot areas sharing x-axis, plus a right-axis for share %
ax_main = fig.add_axes([0.07, 0.17, 0.83, 0.68], facecolor=BG_COLOR)
ax_share = ax_main.twinx()

# ── Background inflection zone (2015-2025) ───────────────────────────────────
ax_main.axvspan(2015, 2025, color=ACCENT_ZONE, alpha=0.45, zorder=0)
ax_main.text(2020, 0.0, "Inflection\nZone", ha='center', va='bottom',
             fontsize=8.5, color='#8B6914', style='italic', fontweight='bold',
             transform=ax_main.get_xaxis_transform(), zorder=5)

# ── Dividing center line ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax_main.axhline(0, color='#888880', linewidth=1.2, linestyle='--', zorder=1)

# ── Clean energy generation share area (scaled to -10..+10 y range) ───────────
share_years = [d[0] for d in share_data]
share_vals  = [d[1] for d in share_data]

# Project onto upper half: share 19–62 → 1..9
def share_to_y(pct):
    return (pct - 15) / (65 - 15) * 8 + 1   # maps 15–65% → 1–9

sy_scaled = [share_to_y(v) for v in share_vals]

# Split historical vs projection at 2024
split = next(i for i, (yr, _) in enumerate(share_data) if yr > 2024)
hist_yrs  = share_years[:split+1]
hist_sy   = sy_scaled[:split+1]
proj_yrs  = share_years[split:]
proj_sy   = sy_scaled[split:]

ax_main.fill_between(hist_yrs, 0, hist_sy, alpha=0.10,
                     color='#1A73E8', zorder=1)
ax_main.plot(hist_yrs, hist_sy, color='#1A73E8', linewidth=2.2, zorder=3,
             label='_nolegend_')
ax_main.fill_between(proj_yrs, 0, proj_sy, alpha=0.06,
                     color='#1A73E8', zorder=1, linestyle='--')
ax_main.plot(proj_yrs, proj_sy, color='#1A73E8', linewidth=2.2, zorder=3,
             linestyle='--', label='_nolegend_')

# ── Right-axis ticks for share % ─────────────────────────────────────────────
pct_ticks = [20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60]
ax_share.set_ylim(ax_main.get_ylim()[0], ax_main.get_ylim()[1])
ax_share.set_yticks([share_to_y(p) for p in pct_ticks])
ax_share.set_yticklabels([f"{p}%" for p in pct_ticks],
                          fontsize=8, color='#1A73E8')
ax_share.tick_params(axis='y', colors='#1A73E8', length=3)
ax_share.spines['right'].set_color('#1A73E8')
ax_share.set_ylabel("Clean Energy Generation Share",
                     fontsize=9, color='#1A73E8', labelpad=10)

# ── Scatter: jitter same-year same-track events ───────────────────────────────
from collections import defaultdict
year_track_count = defaultdict(int)

def get_y(track, sub_type, sig, year):
    key = (year, track)
    idx = year_track_count[key]
    year_track_count[key] += 1
    base = 1.5 if track == "clean" else -1.5
    # Stack multiple events in same year/track
    offset = idx * (0.9 if track == "clean" else -0.9)
    return base + offset

for (yr, track, sub, label, sig) in events:
    y = get_y(track, sub, sig, yr)
    size = (sig ** 1.85) * 2.8
    color = SUB_COLORS[sub]
    edge = "white" if track == "clean" else "#FAFAFA"
    ax_main.scatter(yr, y, s=size, color=color, edgecolors=edge,
                    linewidths=0.9, zorder=6, alpha=0.92)

# ── Annotation labels for high-significance events (sig >= 8) ────────────────
labeled = []
for (yr, track, sub, label, sig) in events:
    if sig < 8:
        continue
    # rebuild y
    key = (yr, track)
    # count how many prior events have sig >= 8 for this key
    prior = sum(1 for (y2, t2, s2, l2, g2) in events
                if y2 == yr and t2 == track and g2 >= 8 and
                events.index((y2, t2, s2, l2, g2)) < events.index((yr, track, sub, label, sig)))
    base = 1.5 if track == "clean" else -1.5
    y = base + prior * (0.9 if track == "clean" else -0.9)

    short = label[:42] + ("…" if len(label) > 42 else "")
    va = 'bottom' if track == "clean" else 'top'
    ya = y + (0.25 if track == "clean" else -0.25)
    ax_main.annotate(short, xy=(yr, y), xytext=(yr, ya),
                     fontsize=6.2, ha='center', va=va,
                     color='#2a2a2a', zorder=7,
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#aaaaaa',
                                     lw=0.6),
                     bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', fc='white',
                               ec='#cccccc', alpha=0.82, lw=0.5))

# ── Track labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax_main.text(1999.3, 5.5, "CLEAN ENERGY\nMILESTONES", fontsize=8.5,
             color='#0d5a2e', fontweight='bold', va='center', ha='left',
             alpha=0.85)
ax_main.text(1999.3, -5.5, "FOSSIL ENERGY\nRETIREMENT", fontsize=8.5,
             color='#5c2d0a', fontweight='bold', va='center', ha='left',
             alpha=0.85)

# ── Axes formatting ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax_main.set_xlim(1999, 2026)
ax_main.set_ylim(-9, 9)
ax_main.set_yticks([])
ax_main.set_xticks(range(2000, 2027, 2))
ax_main.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9, colors='#444')
ax_main.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_main.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax_main.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_main.spines['bottom'].set_color(GRID_COLOR)
ax_main.grid(axis='x', color=GRID_COLOR, linestyle=':', linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)

ax_main.set_xlabel("Year", fontsize=10, labelpad=6, color='#444')

# ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sub_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=SUB_COLORS["coal"],     label="Coal (fossil)"),
    mpatches.Patch(color=SUB_COLORS["oil"],      label="Oil (fossil)"),
    mpatches.Patch(color=SUB_COLORS["gas"],      label="Gas (fossil)"),
    mpatches.Patch(color=SUB_COLORS["solar"],    label="Solar (clean)"),
    mpatches.Patch(color=SUB_COLORS["wind"],     label="Wind (clean)"),
    mpatches.Patch(color=SUB_COLORS["hydrogen"], label="Hydrogen (clean)"),
]
size_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor='#888',
           markeredgecolor='#888', markersize=np.sqrt((s**1.85)*2.8/np.pi)*2,
           label=f"Significance {s}")
    for s in [4, 6, 9]
]
share_handle = Line2D([0], [0], color='#1A73E8', linewidth=2.2,
                      label="Clean energy share (%, right axis)")
proj_handle  = Line2D([0], [0], color='#1A73E8', linewidth=2.2,
                      linestyle='--', label="  projected (post-2024)")
zone_handle  = mpatches.Patch(color=ACCENT_ZONE, alpha=0.7,
                               label="2015–2025 inflection zone")

leg = ax_main.legend(
    handles=sub_handles + [zone_handle, share_handle, proj_handle],
    loc='lower left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, -0.22),
    ncol=5, fontsize=8, frameon=True,
    framealpha=0.9, edgecolor=GRID_COLOR,
    title="Energy sub-type  ·  Marker size ∝ significance score",
    title_fontsize=7.5
)

# ── Title block ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.07, 0.91,
         "Global Energy Transition: Dual-Track Timeline (2000–2025)",
         fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a')
fig.text(0.07, 0.875,
         "Fossil retirement events (below) vs. clean energy milestones (above) · "
         "Marker size = significance · Area = clean share of global electricity generation",
         fontsize=9, color='#555')

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=160, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=BG_COLOR)
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
